Independent cyclic patch-path algebra and rational reproduction
correctness.rationale: Reversal follows by transposing the product and cyclically moving one common symmetric P; in two dimensions trace and the order-independent determinant fix the spectrum. These symmetries exhaust all permutations through three phases and give three dihedral classes at four. In the cyclic patch-path expansion only the terms with two visits to each patch depend on placement: adjacent pairs carry p²(1−p)² and opposite pairs p⁴. With B=∏b_j and K=p²(1−2p), the order-dependent correction to an order-independent baseline is −KB(r_i r_k+r_j r_l) for the word ijkl. Subtracting the three opposite-pair sums yields all three Δ-products, including the tie cases and the reversal at half dispersal. The common four-phase determinant and positivity make the Perron root strictly increasing in trace; at p=1/2 the rank-one scalar result is 2^(−m)∏(a_j+b_j). A separate rational patch-path computation reproduced the common determinant 6442450944/500246412961 and the two opposite signs at one, with the smaller eigenvalue below one. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/reproduce_triangle_seasons.py, output /workspace/branches/triangle_seasons_reproduction.txt. The result is about asymptotic linear growth, not nonlinear persistence.

originality.rationale: Distinct indexed record 3268e9366f52 already supplies the equivalent discrete two-patch theorem, including invariance through three phases, exactly the three differences (hence all ties), reversal at 1/2, and a threshold-crossing example. The opposite within-phase convention cannot distinguish the spectra: transposing the chronological product of P D_i gives exactly the frozen written product of D_i P. Its numerical example is different, but just witnesses the same effect on the other side of 1/2. The catalogue labels differ; this finding of equivalent existing coverage is not a ruling that the Nov. 2 version was historically first, nor an allegation of copying. No substantively distinct remainder is established.
residual_risks: Relationship and historical priority of the frozen and equivalent indexed records are not established by their catalogue labels.
Schreiber (2010) and Caswell–Trevisan (1994) full texts were not obtained; the equivalence decision does not depend on either inaccessible paper.
